summary: Found an oversell across two servers. Stock reservation in reserve-inventory.ts wraps createReservationItems in Modules.LOCKING, which defaults to the in-memory provider and only serializes within one process. A race with SOLO (stock 1) completed on two servers at once produced two orders in 9 of 13 runs, failing no_oversell and reserved_matches_reservations (the reserved counter was a lost update of the read-then-write in inventory-module.ts). The one_order_per_cart, orphan and missing-order checks passed.
